scripts.build: npm run sync && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.smoke: npm run sync && vite build --ssr smoke/main.ts --outDir node_modules/.tmp/smoke --logLevel error && node node_modules/.tmp/smoke/main.js
scripts.integracao: npm run sync && vite build --ssr smoke/main-integracao.ts --outDir node_modules/.tmp/int --logLevel error && node node_modules/.tmp/int/main-integracao.js
